_comment: The pack's progression route, source for the FTB Quests book. tools/quests/build.py turns it into config/ftbquests/quests/ and checks it against the progression checker. Each quest: key (unique), title, subtitle, desc (lines), item (an item task, detected automatically) or checkmark: true (the player ticks it), deps (quest keys, any chapter), big (drawn larger), optional, extra_items (more item tasks).
title: The Route

quests.title: The Route
quests.subtitle: TFC, then Create, then GregTech
desc: TerraFirmaCraft on a real-scale Earth, mechanized with Create, industrialized with GregTech, with airships from Create Aeronautics.
The route: TFC's stone, copper and bronze ages; Create from the bronze age; TFC's iron; GregTech's steam age, which runs on Create parts; TFC steel; GregTech electricity. Airships open with brass.
Look up any recipe in EMI: hover an item and press R for its recipes, U for its uses. TFC's field guide explains survival, knapping, pottery and metalworking.
On a server, /startat <latitude> <longitude> moves you once to any place on Earth (south and west are negative), e.g. /startat 59.33 18.07 for Stockholm.

quests.title: Stone Tools
quests.subtitle: Knap loose rocks
desc: Pick up loose rocks and sticks from the ground. Knap rocks into tool heads (use two rocks), then craft a head with a stick. A knife and an axe come first.

quests.title: Fire
quests.subtitle: A firepit
desc: Throw one log and three sticks on the ground and use a firestarter on them. The firepit cooks food, heats metal and later lights pit kilns and charcoal pits.

quests.title: Pottery
quests.subtitle: A fired small vessel
desc: Knap clay into a small vessel and ingot molds, then fire them in a pit kiln (straw and logs over the pottery, lit).

quests.title: Copper
quests.subtitle: Your first metal
desc: Melt native copper, malachite or tetrahedrite in a small vessel and pour it into a fired ingot mold.
TFC ores come in grades: small 10 mB, poor 15, normal 25, rich 35; an ingot is 100 mB.

quests.title: Copper Anvil
quests.subtitle: Metalworking
desc: Weld ingots into double ingots and shape them on a stone anvil. The anvil makes tools, sheets and most metal parts.

quests.title: Bronze
quests.subtitle: Copper and tin
desc: Alloy copper (88-92%) with tin from cassiterite (8-12%) in a vessel. Bismuth bronze and black bronze work too.

quests.title: Bronze Anvil
quests.subtitle: For brass and iron
desc: A tier-2 anvil works brass and bronze; wrought iron needs it too.

quests.title: Brass
quests.subtitle: Copper and zinc
desc: Alloy copper (88-92%) with zinc from sphalerite (8-12%). Brass is Create's precision metal and the airship metal.

quests.title: Charcoal
quests.subtitle: Fuel that burns hot
desc: Stack logs in a pit, cover them and light them: a charcoal pit. Charcoal is hot enough for a forge, the bloomery and the blast furnace.

quests.title: Andesite Alloy
quests.subtitle: Create starts here
desc: In this pack andesite alloy takes any TFC igneous extrusive rock (andesite, basalt, dacite or rhyolite; raw or cobble) plus zinc or bronze nuggets.
Craft an ingot into nine nuggets.

quests.title: Shafts and Cogwheels
quests.subtitle: Moving parts
desc: Shafts from andesite alloy, cogwheels from shafts and planks. TFC workbenches count as crafting tables everywhere.

quests.title: Power
quests.subtitle: A water wheel
desc: Put a water wheel in a river. TFC: Real World's rivers follow real rivers.

quests.title: Millstone
quests.subtitle: Grinding ore
desc: Besides Create's usual milling, it grinds TFC ores into GregTech crushed ore at TFC's own yield: a rich piece gives a crushed ore 35% of the time, a normal one 25%.

quests.title: Belts
quests.subtitle: Leather or burlap
desc: TFC worlds have no vanilla kelp, so belts, the spout, funnels, tunnels and pulleys take leather, burlap cloth or dried kelp.

quests.title: Mechanical Pump
quests.subtitle: The steam age needs it
desc: Every GregTech boiler is built around a Create mechanical pump, so GregTech's steam age starts here.

quests.title: Brass Casing
quests.subtitle: Precision machinery
desc: A brass sheet on a stripped log (TFC logs count). Propellers, smart machines and airships build on it.

quests.title: Mechanical Press
quests.subtitle: Heavy machines
desc: Takes a TFC wrought iron double sheet. Presses ingots into GregTech plates one for one (by hand, GregTech takes two ingots per plate).

quests.title: Encased Fan
quests.subtitle: Bulk smelting
desc: Blowing through lava or fire smelts items like a furnace: crushed copper becomes copper ingots. Crushed iron ores become cast iron; only the bloomery makes wrought iron.

quests.title: Mechanical Saw
quests.subtitle: Wires
desc: Slits a GregTech plate into two single wires (copper, tin, red alloy, gold, ...), GregTech's wiremill rate without electricity.

quests.title: Crushing Wheels
quests.subtitle: Ore at GregTech's rate
desc: Crush TFC ores into GregTech crushed ore at the macerator's rate, twice TFC's yield: a rich piece gives a crushed ore 70% of the time.

quests.title: Bloomery
quests.subtitle: The only way to wrought iron
desc: Built from bronze double sheets, with charcoal and iron ore inside.
Wrought iron comes only from the bloomery: anything iron that is smelted or melted (GregTech's furnaces, Create's fan, TFC heat) becomes cast iron.

quests.title: Wrought Iron
quests.subtitle: Iron means wrought iron
desc: Refine the bloom on the anvil. In this pack every iron ingot, plate and rod is TFC wrought iron.

quests.title: Wrought Iron Double Sheet
quests.subtitle: For the press
desc: Weld two wrought iron sheets. Create's mechanical press needs one.

quests.title: Blast Furnace
quests.subtitle: Pig iron
desc: TFC's blast furnace turns iron ore, charcoal and flux into pig iron. GregTech's electric blast furnace is later built from one.

quests.title: Pig Iron
quests.subtitle: On the way to steel
desc: Cast the blast furnace's molten pig iron into ingots. Pig iron is the only way to steel, whether worked on the anvil or refined in GregTech's primitive blast furnace.

quests.title: Steel
quests.subtitle: Only from pig iron
desc: Work pig iron on the anvil into high-carbon steel and then steel, or refine pig iron with charcoal or coke in GregTech's primitive blast furnace.

quests.title: Fire Bricks
quests.subtitle: Fireboxes
desc: Fire clay bricks, fired and set with mortar. GregTech's steam machines use them where they wanted a vanilla furnace.

quests.title: Steam Boiler
quests.subtitle: GregTech begins
desc: Bronze plates, TFC fire bricks and a Create mechanical pump. It burns logs or charcoal. Every steam machine runs on boiler steam, and later the steam turbine turns it into electricity.

quests.title: Steam Macerator
quests.subtitle: Twice the ore
desc: Crushes TFC ore pieces into GregTech crushed ore at twice TFC's yield: 5 small, 10 poor, 2 normal or 10 rich pieces give 1, 3, 1 or 7 crushed ores. Mineral and gem ores give 2 each.

quests.title: Ore Processing
quests.subtitle: Crushed ore
desc: Crushed ore comes from Create's millstone and crushing wheels or GregTech's macerator. Wash it in a cauldron or ore washer, smelt it in a steam furnace or with Create's fan, or keep processing it for byproducts. Crushed hematite, magnetite, limonite and pyrite smelt into cast iron.

quests.title: Steam Alloy Smelter
quests.subtitle: Red alloy and rubber
desc: Runs GregTech's alloy recipes on steam: red alloy from copper and redstone (grind cinnabar or cryolite in a TFC quern), rubber from raw rubber and sulfur.

quests.title: Rubber
quests.subtitle: For cables
desc: Sticky resin from GregTech's rubber trees goes into a steam extractor for raw rubber; alloy-smelt it with sulfur (crush TFC sulfur or pyrite). Create's press turns rubber into plates.

quests.title: Primitive Blast Furnace
quests.subtitle: Faster steel
desc: Refines TFC pig iron with charcoal, coal or coke into steel, faster than working it on the anvil. It takes pig iron only.

quests.title: High-Pressure Steam
quests.subtitle: Steel boilers
desc: Steel boilers make steam faster; high-pressure steam machines run at full speed.

quests.title: LV Machine Hull
quests.subtitle: Steel and cable
desc: Steel plates and tin cable (tin wire covered in rubber). Every LV machine starts as a hull.

quests.title: LV Motor
quests.subtitle: Around a Create shaft
desc: GregTech's LV motors are built around two Create shafts, with copper wire and a magnetic iron rod.

quests.title: Steam Turbine
quests.subtitle: Electricity
desc: Electricity comes from boiler steam: feed an LV steam turbine from your boilers and cable it to your machines.

quests.title: Pumps and Pistons
quests.subtitle: Create inside
desc: LV pumps contain a Create mechanical pump, LV pistons a Create cogwheel.

quests.title: Circuits
quests.subtitle: Electronic circuit
desc: Vacuum tubes, resistors and red alloy cable on a circuit board. Circuits gate every LV machine.

quests.title: Assembler
quests.subtitle: GregTech's workhorse
desc: Most of GregTech's LV recipes go through the assembler.

quests.title: Electric Blast Furnace
quests.subtitle: The next tier
desc: Built from TFC's blast furnace, heat-proof invar casings and LV circuits. It needs cupronickel coils and electricity to run.

quests.title: Physics Assembler
quests.subtitle: Builds that move
desc: Turns a build into a moving physics contraption: carts, boats and airships. Ground vehicles need no brass.

quests.title: Envelopes
quests.subtitle: The balloon
desc: Hot-air envelopes take wool and brass nuggets: two nuggets for four envelopes by hand, one for three with a deployer. Build them into a closed balloon.

quests.title: Hot-Air Burner
quests.subtitle: Lift
desc: Fills a balloon with hot air. It runs on redstone and burns no fuel. Brass plates, wrought iron plates and any coal or charcoal.

quests.title: Propeller Bearing
quests.subtitle: Thrust
desc: Every propeller sits on brass casing. Spin it with any Create power on board.

quests.title: Portable Engine
quests.subtitle: Power on board
desc: A fuel-burning rotation source for vehicles: an engine assembly, a brass plate and TFC fire bricks.

quests.title: Steam Lift
quests.subtitle: Optional
desc: A brass plate on a copper block. Like a Create steam engine it sits on a heated, watered fluid-tank boiler, and vents the steam into the balloon above: another way to lift.
